args.command:
cat > build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
s='[BH-](n1nc(C(F)(F)F)c(Br)c1C(F)(F)F)(n1nc(C(F)(F)F)c(Br)c1C(F)(F)F)n1nc(C(F)(F)F)c(Br)c1C(F)(F)F.[Ag+].[C](c1ccccc1)C1=C(c2ccccc2)C(=O)OC1'
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(s)
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 print(a.GetIdx(),a.GetSymbol(),a.GetFormalCharge(),a.GetNumRadicalElectrons(),[n.GetIdx() for n in a.GetNeighbors()])
ag=next(a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=='Ag')
nn=[a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=='N' and not any(n.GetSymbol()=='B' for n in a.GetNeighbors())]
carb=ag+1
rw=Chem.RWMol(m)
for n in nn:rw.AddBond(n,ag,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)
rw.AddBond(ag,carb,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
rw.GetAtomWithIdx(carb).SetNumRadicalElectrons(0)
m=rw.GetMol(); Chem.SanitizeMol(m); m=Chem.AddHs(m)
print('atoms',m.GetNumAtoms(),'ag',ag,'donors',nn,'carb',carb)
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3();p.randomSeed=106;p.useRandomCoords=True;p.maxIterations=2000
ok=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,p)
print('embed',ok)
if ok>=0:
 Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'initial.mol')
 x=m.GetConformer().GetPositions()
 for n in nn+[carb]:print('AGB',n,np.linalg.norm(x[ag]-x[n]))
 with open('initial.xyz','w') as f:
  f.write(f'{len(x)}\nTp Ag carbene complex\n')
  for a,v in zip(m.GetAtoms(),x):f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol()} {v[0]:.8f} {v[1]:.8f} {v[2]:.8f}\n')
PY
python build.py > build.log 2>&1; cat build.log
OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 xtb initial.xyz --gfn 2 --opt --chrg 0 --uhf 0 > xtb.log 2>&1 & echo $!

cat > render.py <<'PY'
import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
m=Chem.MolFromMolFile('initial.mol',removeHs=False)
l=open('xtbopt.log').readlines();n=int(l[0]);x=np.array([list(map(float,a.split()[1:])) for a in l[-n:]])
# viewing plane includes B-Ag axis and carbene branching carbon
z=x[43]-x[0];z/=np.linalg.norm(z)
u=x[45]-x[51];u-=np.dot(u,z)*z;u/=np.linalg.norm(u)
y=np.cross(z,u)
x=(x-x[43])@np.array([u,y,z]).T
cols={'C':'#444444','N':'#2467de','O':'red','B':'#edb08f','Ag':'#909090','Br':'#912719','F':'#69ca44','H':'#dddddd'}
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(10,8));a=fig.add_subplot(projection='3d')
for b in m.GetBonds():
 i,j=b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx();a.plot(*x[[i,j]].T,color='gray',linewidth=2)
for i,at in enumerate(m.GetAtoms()):
 e=at.GetSymbol();a.scatter(*x[i],s=70 if e=='H' else 180 if e!='Ag' else 320,color=cols[e],edgecolor='black')
 if e in ['Ag','B','N','O']:a.text(*x[i],e,fontsize=10)
a.view_init(elev=12,azim=-70);a.set_box_aspect(np.ptp(x,axis=0));a.axis('off');plt.tight_layout();plt.savefig('render.png',dpi=150)
PY

grep -E 'GEOMETRY OPTIMIZATION|TOTAL ENERGY|HOMO-LUMO|finished|converged' xtb.log | tail -12; python - <<'PY'
import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
from rdkit import Chem
l=open('xtbopt.xyz').read().splitlines(); n=int(l[0]); syms=[s.split()[0] for s in l[2:2+n]]; x=np.array([list(map(float,s.split()[1:4])) for s in l[2:2+n]])
x-=x.mean(axis=0)
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{n}\n3D structure of mol_0106; explicit hydrogens; coordinates in angstroms\n')
 for s,(a,b,c) in zip(syms,x): f.write(f'{s:2s} {a: .8f} {b: .8f} {c: .8f}\n')
print('Atoms:',n,dict(Counter(syms)))
print('Ag-N distances:',[round(np.linalg.norm(x[43]-x[i]),3) for i in [2,16,30]])
print('Ag-C distance:',round(np.linalg.norm(x[43]-x[44]),3))
print('answer.xyz exists:',__import__('os').path.isfile('answer.xyz'))
PY
